description: Reads one place the traveler found themselves into the receipts a pick carries: where it is, whether the street is quiet or lively, bars, cafés and restaurants within a ten-minute walk, the distance to a spot they name and, with dates, the lowest total and the lowest they can still cancel, each read now. Takes a Booking.com, Vrbo or Expedia property page, or a hotel's name and city; Airbnb pages cannot be read. Needs a key: one check a day free, Pro up to thirty. 5 to 60 seconds.

checkIn.description: YYYY-MM-DD; with checkOut, prices are read too

spot.description: A place they will walk to: 'Rainey Street', 'the convention center'

text.description: A property page URL, or a hotel's name with its city after a comma: 'Hilton Austin, Austin'
